assets.name: adr
assets.description: アーキテクチャ決定記録 (ADR) を作成し docs/adr/ に保存する

assets.name: asset-audit
assets.description: 利用側プロジェクトの .claude/ と CLAUDE.md を棚卸しし、削除・改訂・修正の候補を出す

assets.name: autonomous-review
assets.description: 異種AIレビュー・根拠検証・品質ゲートを統合し、ローカルで自動マージ可否を判定する

assets.name: design-doc
assets.description: 要件から設計書を生成し docs/design/ に保存する

assets.name: design-review
assets.description: 設計ドキュメントや実装方針を多観点でレビューする

assets.name: design-sync
assets.description: 設計書と実装の乖離を検知し、status を最新化する

assets.name: doctor
assets.description: aidd/superpowers の導入状態・バージョン整合・hooks 実行可否を診断する

assets.name: eval
assets.description: design-review パイプラインをゴールデンセットで評価し、検出率・誤棄却率を測定する

assets.name: incident-retro
assets.description: セッションで起きた事故を棚卸しし、再発防止の置き場 (コード・hook・CLAUDE.md・memory・コマンド・ADR・issue) を決めて定着させる

assets.name: infra-audit
assets.description: 利用側プロジェクトの静的解析(複雑度制御)・重複コード検出・多OS CI導入状況を診断する

assets.name: issue-split
assets.description: 設計を独立マージ可能なPR単位に分割し、GitHub issue 化する

assets.name: retro
assets.description: aidd 資産の棚卸し。利用実績と陳腐化した資産を洗い出す

assets.name: test-perspectives
assets.description: 実装対象・変更差分からテスト観点を洗い出す

assets.name: adr-recall
assets.description: Use when making an architectural decision, changing existing structure, or proposing a design that could contradict a past decision. Checks docs/adr/ for related ADRs before proceeding.

assets.name: four-kinds-check
assets.description: Use right before git commit when the staged diff adds code comments or test names, or when drafting the commit message, in a project whose CLAUDE.md has the How / What / Why / Why-not comment placement rule or where AIDD_COMMIT_WHY_CANON is set. Not for reviewing someone else's existing code.

assets.name: issue-priority
assets.description: Use when asked to set, review, or triage the priority label of GitHub issues, or when about to file a GitHub issue (gh issue create) in a repository that uses priority labels (AIDD_REQUIRED_LABEL_PREFIX is set, .aidd/issue-priority.md exists, or gh label list shows priority labels). Not for ordering implementation tasks inside a plan.

assets.name: model-selection
assets.description: Use when dispatching a subagent, choosing a model parameter (haiku/sonnet/opus/fable), or unsure whether a task is cheap enough for a smaller model.

assets.name: review-loop
assets.description: Use when running repeated review-fix rounds (design review, PR review, or subagent findings) and deciding when to stop, or when findings arrive in mixed severity vocabularies.

assets.name: design-arbiter
assets.description: Final arbiter for design reviews. Use after parallel reviewer agents return their findings, to resolve contradictions and pick the single highest-priority fix. Requires deep judgment, so it always runs on opus regardless of the main-loop model.

assets.name: refuter
assets.description: Adversarial verifier for review findings. Use after reviewer agents return high/mid findings, to actively attempt to refute each finding against the actual target before it is accepted. Findings that survive refutation are promoted; refuted ones are discarded with reasons.

assets.name: reviewer
assets.description: Code and document reviewer for routine quality checks. Use after a task completes to verify the deliverable matches its requirements. For deep architectural review use the design-review command instead.

assets.name: scout
assets.description: Lightweight read-only investigator. Use for codebase reconnaissance, file inventories, and fact-finding that only needs conclusions, not analysis. Dispatch multiple scouts in parallel for independent questions.

assets.name: security-reviewer
assets.description: STRIDE-based threat reviewer for designs that cross trust boundaries (external input, authn/authz, secrets, public endpoints). Launched conditionally by design-review; also usable standalone on a design document.

assets.name: source-verifier
assets.description: Verifies externally checkable claims in a design document (tech choices, API/spec assertions, version compatibility) against official docs and specs. Opt-in via design-review's --verify-sources flag.

assets.name: session-start
assets.description: [SessionStart] SessionStart hook: surface aidd assets so they are used without relying on memory.

assets.name: tool-reminder
assets.description: [PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PreToolUse] Event-aware Bash hook dispatcher (PreToolUse + PostToolUse). Every check runs in this one

assets.name: usage-log
assets.description: [PreToolUse, UserPromptSubmit] UserPromptSubmit + PreToolUse(Skill) hook: log aidd command usage for /aidd:retro.

assets.name: write-guard
assets.description: [PreToolUse] Write/Edit/NotebookEdit guard for new files: unreadable names, and assets aidd already has.
